Servicios de despliegue progresivo de cobertura de llamadas de la plataforma en todos los centros de atención primaria y hospitales dependientes de la CS que se encuentren en funcionamiento en la fecha de inicio del contrato, así como en aquellos que se incorporen durante el período de ejecución del mismo, sin que ello suponga variación del precio ofertado. signal.description: En el ámbito de la seguridad vial, el enfoque del Sistema Seguro, reconocido internacionalmente y recogido en la “Política de Seguridad Vial de la Unión Europea 2021-2030” y el “Plan de acción estratégico sobre seguridad vial” de la Comisión Europea, sugiere adquirir un mayor conocimiento sobre las distintas variables que influyen sobre la siniestralidad vial —más allá de los indicadores habituales, como el número de accidentes, fallecidos y heridos graves—, recomendando obtener otros indicadores, llamados Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), indicadores clave de rendimiento, directamente relacionados con la prevención de muertes y lesiones en accidentes de tráfico. Entre estos indicadores, se encuentran el uso del cinturón de seguridad y de sistemas de retención infantil, el uso del casco, los vehículos que circulan dentro del límite de velocidad, los conductores que circulan dentro del límite legal de tasa de alcohol en sangre, las distracciones al volante y la seguridad de los vehículos. Estos indicadores constituyen el objeto de la presente licitación. El objeto de este lote es el diseño de un muestreo para los lotes 2 y 3 y para el indicador de alcohol y Estudio EDAP, obtención de los KPI (salvo para el KPI 6, cuyos trabajos de cálculo quedan dentro del ámbito del lote 4), y elaboración del cuadro de mando.; El objetivo del lote 2 consiste en la realización de mediciones de la velocidad y otras características del flujo de vehículos en una muestra de 150 secciones de la red viaria española, con el fin de que sirvan de base para la elaboración y obtención del indicador KPI 1; Realización de trabajos de campo para la recogida de datos sobre el uso del cinturón de seguridad, sistemas de retención infantil (SRI), casco y conducción utilizando dispositivos móviles, mediante la realización de encuestas no participativas en una muestra de secciones de vías urbanas e interurbanas, que permitan al adjudicatario del lote 1 obtener estos indicadores (KPI 2, 3 y 5).; El objeto de este lote es la obtención del indicador de seguridad de los vehículos (KPI 6).; El objeto de este lote es la gestión y supervisión de trabajos de lotes 1,2,3 y 4.

translation.description: In the field of road safety, the Safe System approach, recognised internationally and included in the “European Union Road Safety Policy 2021-2030” and the European Commission’s “Strategic Action Plan on Road Safety”, suggests acquiring greater knowledge about the different variables that influence road accidents —beyond the usual indicators, such as the number of accidents, deaths and serious injuries—, recommending the acquisition of other indicators, called Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), directly related to the prevention of deaths and injuries in traffic accidents. Among these indicators are the use of seat belts and child restraint systems, the use of helmets, vehicles travelling within the speed limit, drivers travelling within the legal blood alcohol limit, driver distractions and vehicle safety. These indicators constitute the object of this tender. The object of this lot is the design of a sampling plan for lots 2 and 3 and for the alcohol indicator and EDAP Study, obtaining the KPIs (except for KPI 6, whose calculation work remains within the scope of lot 4), and preparation of the dashboard.; The objective of lot 2 consists of carrying out measurements of speed and other characteristics of vehicle flow in a sample of 150 sections of the Spanish road network, in order to serve as a basis for the preparation and acquisition of the KPI 1 indicator; Carrying out fieldwork for the collection of data on the use of seat belts, child restraint systems (CRS), helmets and driving using mobile devices, by conducting non-participatory surveys in a sample of urban and interurban road sections, which allow the successful bidder of lot 1 to obtain these indicators (KPI 2, 3 and 5).; The object of this lot is the acquisition of the vehicle safety indicator (KPI 6).; The object of this lot is the management and supervision of the work of lots 1,2,3 and 4.
translation.title: Service for the preparation of reports on key performance indicators in road safety. 5 lots.

signal.title: CivTech 12.6 - How can technology improve living conditions and quality of life for social housing residents in Scotland?
signal.description: Cold homes, damp, mould and fuel poverty are driving poor health outcomes, increasing pressure on healthcare services and deepening inequalities. While Registered Social Landlords are investing in warmer, more energy-efficient housing and responding to new regulatory requirements, fuel poverty means many vulnerable residents remain at risk, even in high-quality homes. Current approaches are often reactive and lack mechanisms to target support for those that might be the very most vulnerable, addressing issues only after harm has occurred. This Challenge seeks innovative solutions that can help registered social landlords identify where housing conditions, fuel poverty and individual vulnerability combine to create the greatest risk of harm, then translate that insight into practical, targeted action that combats these impacts, improves tenants’ health and wellbeing outcomes, protects homes and makes better use of limited housing and support resources. Solutions must be affordable at RSL scale, protect tenant privacy, and connect insight to action so that Cloch can complete investigation and repair work within statutory timescales.

signal.title: Procedura aperta, ai sensi dell’art. 71 del D.Lgs. n. 36/2023, per l’affidamento dei servizi di sviluppo, manutenzione e gestione del sistema informativo di Fondimpresa (Sistema FPF)
signal.description: Procedura aperta, ai sensi dell’art. 71 del D.Lgs. n. 36/2023, per l’affidamento dei servizi di sviluppo, manutenzione e gestione del sistema informativo di Fondimpresa (Sistema FPF) Con l’aggiudicatario della presente procedura verrà stipulato un Contratto avente ad oggetto le seguenti attività:i) Sviluppo software e MEV ii) Manutenzione Correttiva e Adeguativa (MAC/MAD) iii) Housing, conduzione e manutenzione HW/SW iv) Helpdesk (nel seguito anche solo “Servizio” o “Servizi”), così come meglio definiti, descritti ed articolati nel Capitolato tecnico allegato al Disciplinare di gara.Deve essere garantito un periodo di affiancamento al nuovo aggiudicatario che subentrerà a fine contratto, della durata di almeno di 2 (due) mesi. Per le modalità di svolgimento del rapporto contrattuale si veda quanto stabilito al paragrafo 9 del Capitolato tecnico, fermo restando il rispetto dei Livelli di servizio di cui al paragrafo 10 del Capitolato tecnico, pena l’applicazione delle penali ivi stabilite. Al fine di rappresentare il contesto di riferimento, fermo quanto meglio stabilito nel Capitolato tecnico, si precisa che Fondimpresa si è dotata di un Sistema Informativo (denominato “Sistema FPF”) per la gestione dei Piani formativi del Conto Formazione e del Conto di Sistema, per la comunicazione fra Fondimpresa, le proprie Articolazioni Territoriali e le aziende aderenti, per l'acquisizione e la gestione dei dati delle adesioni e dei contributi trasmessi dall'INPS, nonché delle informazioni di monitoraggio da inviare periodicamente al Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali e per la registrazione degli aiuti di stato presso l’RNA. Lo sviluppo delle attività del Fondo, la diversificazione delle misure di finanziamento della formazione messe a disposizione delle aziende aderenti (tramite avvisi pubblici), l'incremento dei finanziamenti concessi e del numero di Piani formativi gestiti, la crescita costante delle adesioni e l'evoluzione delle specifiche di monitoraggio richieste dall'Autorità di indirizzo e vigilanza, comportano la necessità di garantire: • la manutenzione evolutiva (MEV) del sistema FPF; • la manutenzione correttiva e adeguativa (MAC/MAD) del sistema FPF; • la gestione dei servizi di Housing e conduzione con particolare attenzione alle attività di monitoraggio dei sistemi e di verifica degli aspetti di sicurezza (penetration test, vulnerability assessment ecc.); • la gestione del servizio di Helpdesk di primo e secondo livello. • lo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità di gestione dei flussi documentali in ottica di una continua e progressiva attività di dematerializzazione delle attività del Fondo; • l’integrazione di nuovi strumenti basati sull’intelligenza artificiale per automatizzare e ottimizzare i flussi operativi umani; • le evoluzioni architetturali e interventi di modernizzazione dell’infrastruttura hardware/software per garantire idonei livelli di sicurezza, efficienza e continuità del servizio; • il supporto applicativo per il sistema di Disaster Recovery. La platea di utenti ad oggi stimata è di circa 280.000 utenti a fronte di circa 210.000 posizioni contributive aderenti a Fondimpresa.L’appalto avrà una durata di 60 mesi naturali e consecutivi, con decorrenza della data di inizio delle attività determinata dalla data di un apposito verbale di avvio delle attività. Per tutti i servizi descritti nel precedente articolo non sono rilevabili rischi interferenti per i quali sia necessario adottare specifiche misure di sicurezza e, pertanto, non risulta necessaria la predisposizione del DUVRI (ex art. 26, comma 3-bis, D.Lgs. n. 81/2008). Non sussistono, di conseguenza, costi della sicurezza di natura interferenziale che sono pertanto quantificati in € 0,00.Poiché la procedura di gara ha ad oggetto servizi di natura intellettuale (in quanto trattasi prevalentemente di sviluppo software ed elaborazione di soluzioni personalizzate, di analisi funzionali e governo dell’evoluzione del sistema), non viene richiesto ai concorrenti di indicare, ai sensi dell’art. 108, comma 9, del Codice, l’ammontare dei costi della manodopera e degli oneri aziendali per l’adempimento delle disposizioni in materia di salute e sicurezza sui luoghi di lavoro.Si rinvia al Disciplinare di Gara e al suo Capitolato tecnico allegato per le specifiche di gara.L’appalto è costituito da un unico lotto poiché è caratterizzato da unitarietà funzionale del servizio. Pertanto, si ritiene opportuno, sia sotto il profilo della convenienza economica sia sotto il profilo dell’ottimale esecuzione del servizio, non procedere alla suddivisione in lotti. In ogni caso la futura offerta del concorrente si intenderà riferita complessivamente alla globalità delle prestazioni oggetto di gara.

translation.description: Open procedure, pursuant to Article 71 of Legislative Decree No 36/2023, for the award of development, maintenance and management services for the information system of Fondimpresa (FPF System). A contract concerning the following activities shall be concluded with the successful tenderer of this procedure: i) Software development and enhancement (MEV) ii) Corrective and adaptive maintenance (MAC/MAD) iii) Housing, operation and hardware/software maintenance iv) Helpdesk (hereinafter also referred to solely as "Service" or "Services"), as better defined, described and set out in the technical specification attached to the tender specifications. A handover period with the new successful tenderer taking over at the end of the contract must be guaranteed, lasting at least 2 (two) months. Regarding the procedures for executing the contractual relationship, please refer to the provisions in paragraph 9 of the technical specification, without prejudice to compliance with the service levels referred to in paragraph 10 of the technical specification, failing which the penalties established therein shall apply. In order to outline the background context, notwithstanding what is better established in the technical specification, it is specified that Fondimpresa has acquired an information system (named "FPF System") for managing the training plans of the Training Account and the System Account, for communication between Fondimpresa, its regional offices and the member companies, for acquiring and managing membership data and contributions transmitted by INPS, as well as monitoring information to be sent periodically to the Ministry of Labour and Social Policies and for registering state aid with the RNA. The development of the Fund's activities, the diversification of training financing measures made available to member companies (via public notices), the increase in financing granted and the number of training plans managed, the steady growth in memberships and the evolution of monitoring specifications required by the guidance and supervisory authority, entail the need to guarantee: • evolutionary maintenance (MEV) of the FPF system; • corrective and adaptive maintenance (MAC/MAD) of the FPF system; • management of housing and operation services with particular attention to system monitoring activities and security aspect verification (penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, etc.); • management of the first and second-level helpdesk service; • the development of new document flow management features with a view to continuous and progressive paperless operation of the Fund's activities; • the integration of new tools based on artificial intelligence to automate and optimise human operational workflows; • architectural developments and hardware/software infrastructure modernisation interventions to ensure appropriate levels of security, efficiency and service continuity; • application support for the disaster recovery system. The currently estimated user base is approximately 280.000 users against approximately 210.000 contributing positions affiliated with Fondimpresa. The contract shall have a duration of 60 natural and consecutive months, commencing from the start date of activities determined by the date of a specific record of commencement of activities. For all services described in the preceding article, no interfering risks are identifiable for which specific safety measures need to be adopted and, therefore, the preparation of the DUVRI is not required (pursuant to Article 26, paragraph 3-bis, of Legislative Decree No 81/2008). Consequently, there are no safety costs of an interfering nature, which are therefore quantified as € 0,00. Since the tender procedure has as its object services of an intellectual nature (as these primarily concern software development and the elaboration of customised solutions, functional analysis and governance of system evolution), tenderers are not required to indicate, pursuant to Article 108, paragraph 9, of the Code, the amount of labour costs and company costs for fulfilling provisions regarding health and safety in the workplace. Please refer to the Tender Specifications and its attached technical specification for tender particulars. The contract consists of a single lot as it is characterised by the functional unity of the service. Therefore, it is considered appropriate, both from the perspective of economic efficiency and optimal service execution, not to proceed with a division into lots. In any event, the tenderer's future bid shall be understood to refer overall to the entirety of the services forming the subject matter of the tender.
translation.title: Open procedure, pursuant to Article 71 of Legislative Decree No 36/2023, for the award of development, maintenance and management services for the information system of Fondimpresa (FPF System)

signal.title: Headless Content Management System (CMS) and Digital Experience Platform (DXP) Market Engagement
signal.description: NHS 24 is undertaking market engagement to inform the potential procurement of a Headless Content Management System (CMS) and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). The exercise will explore available solutions, delivery models, implementation approaches and commercial options to support the future NHS 24 digital experience and content management capability. Lot 1: . NHS 24 is undertaking a preliminary market consultation to inform the potential procurement and implementation of a modern Headless Content Management System (CMS) and wider Digital Experience Platform (DXP) capability. The objective is to understand available market solutions, delivery approaches, commercial models and routes to market capable of supporting a secure, scalable and API-driven platform for the creation, management and reuse of content across websites, mobile experiences, conversational interfaces and future digital channels. The potential requirement may include platform licensing, hosting, implementation, systems integration, content modelling, content migration, user experience design, front-end development, training, support, knowledge transfer and ongoing service management. NHS 24 has not yet determined the preferred procurement approach and is seeking supplier input on alternative delivery models, including platform-only, implementation-only, end-to-end and multi-supplier arrangements. This exercise is for market engagement purposes only and does not constitute a formal procurement competition or commitment to procure. Supplier responses will be used to inform NHS 24's future strategy, scope and procurement approach

signal.title: CivTech 12.1 - How can digital technologies assist people living with substance use issues (and their families/friends) to easily connect with trusted help and substance use support when services are unavailable?
signal.description: Scotland has the highest drug and alcohol related death rates in the UK and Europe. People with substance use issues (PWSUI) often need help outside normal 'office' hours or from a distance from offices, and support is not uniformly available throughout Scotland. The support landscape in Scotland is fragmented, hard to navigate, and varies by locality. When support isn’t readily available (or isn’t trusted), people and their families and friends often default to emergency services or remain unsupported. As a result, those who use substances often experience avoidable crisis escalation, or remain in extremely difficult situations, and support services miss opportunities for early, harm-reducing interventions. The Preventing Harm, Promoting Recovery: Scotland’s Alcohol & Drugs Strategic Plan 2026 – 2035 specifically addresses the crucial need to tackle early intervention and widen an individual’s ‘circle of support’. This ‘circle of support’ is at the heart of this Challenge, and a successful solution would enable people to access the right support sooner, regardless of locality. It should harness the power of existing trusted services, family and community to reduce avoidable demand on emergency and NHS services – and if possible, create a ‘feedback loop’ of learning, intelligence and insight so that the overall issue can be tackled in a continually improving manner.

signal.title: Electronic Document Record Management System
signal.description: West Northamptonshire Council (WNC) is a relatively new Local Authority that has inherited a wide range of electronic document systems and storage methods from predecessor councils. These legacy solutions vary in functionality, levels of automation, and overall maturity, which often results in manual processes to meet compliance, retention, and operational needs. Key services such as Housing, Revenues & Benefits, Regulatory Services, the post room and Pensions and Payroll rely heavily on electronic document and records management to process and store critical information from residents, businesses, and other stakeholders. The Council uses several inherited systems for records management, each supporting different service areas. Additionally, WNC have an archive and heritage service that require archiving for long-term retention of digital materials. The project will consider opportunities to bring these capabilities together into a more consistent and modern corporate approach; in some cases, for archive data only.

Edellä mainittuja hankitaan sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon organisaatioille tuotettaviin palveluihin, jotka nimetään tarkemmin DPS sisäisen kilpailutuksen tarjouspyynnössä. Ratkaisuja voidaan hankkia käytettäväksi erikoissairaanhoidossa, perusterveydenhuollossa ja sosiaalitoimessa, sekä näihin tehtäviin liittyvissä tukitoimissa. Ne voidaan ottaa käyttöön 2M-IT Oy:n palvelutuotannossa osana yhden tai useamman asiakkaan palveluja. Lisäksi 2M-IT Oy voi hankkia ratkaisuja myös oman liiketoimintansa tarpeisiin. translation.description: 2M-IT Oy (hereinafter also the "Contracting Authority" or "Client") is establishing a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for data-driven management and artificial intelligence services. Organisations providing services under the dynamic purchasing system (DPS) may submit requests to participate in the dynamic purchasing system throughout its duration. All candidates who have submitted a request to participate and who meet the suitability requirements set for candidates will be admitted to the dynamic purchasing system. The internal competitions of the dynamic purchasing system to be established will cover data-driven management and AI platforms, solutions and services, licences, and expert services, as well as various combinations thereof. The aforementioned are to be procured for services produced for social and healthcare organisations, which will be specified in more detail in the call for tenders for the DPS internal competition. Solutions may be procured for use in specialised medical care, primary healthcare, and social services, as well as in support activities related to these tasks. They may be implemented in the service production of 2M-IT Oy as part of the services for one or more clients. In addition, 2M-IT Oy may also procure solutions for the needs of its own business operations. The actual procurements will be made on the basis of separate calls for tenders as internal competitions within the DPS, in which the contracting authority will specify and describe its detailed procurement need. The subject of the procurement of platforms and licences may be, for example, a solution based on commercial off-the-shelf software for data-driven management or AI, software usage rights, licences, and/or an open-source software solution. The subject may also include, among other things, tools for data-driven management, data warehouse automation, integration, analytics and reporting, and visualisation. The solutions and services to be procured may consist of the supplier's own services and products or services and products licensed by a subcontractor provided through the supplier. In service production, either the Client's existing own operating service and other capacity can be utilised, or this can be included in the subject of the procurement. The subject of expert services can be specified in areas such as: • Data-driven management and AI consulting • Planning and management of data management and governance projects • Concept, data, and interface modelling and architecture definition • Development, testing, training, and planning of maintenance, management, and monitoring of data pipelines (ETL) and integrations • Knowledge of open interfaces and standards and integrating AI as part of applications • Planning, development, testing, training, and planning of maintenance, management, and monitoring of data warehouses, data cubes, and data lakes • Development of analytics, advanced analytics, machine learning, and robotics • Development of AI algorithms into finished products in various technologies • Implementation expertise in various technologies (e.g. Google AI, AWS Cloud computing, Microsoft AI) • User interface and application development (Chatbot etc.) • Definition and development of cost accounting • Definition of services, processes, and governance models • Selection, consulting, and training of tools used in development • Machine training, converting original material into a processable format, and teaching artificial intelligence
translation.title: Knowledge management and artificial intelligence (AI) services

signal.title: Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity Education Innovation and Scholarship for Service (CyberAI SFS)
signal.description: Government and the nation face a talent shortfall in artificial intelligence (AI) and cybersecurity. The CyberAICorps Scholarship for Service ( CyberAI SFS ) program welcomes proposals that address AI and cybersecurity education and workforce development. CyberAI refers to using AI in cybersecurity as well as providing security and resilience for AI systems. The Scholarship Track provides funding to establish, or to continue, scholarship for service programs with integrated AI and cybersecurity components (CyberAI). Scholarship recipients must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents and work after graduation in the AI or cybersecurity mission of a government organization for a period of at least the length of the scholarship. The Innovation Track supports projects that enhance preparation of AI and/or cybersecurity professionals. Projects may expand existing educational opportunities, curricula, degree programs, educational pathways, methods and interventions, and partnerships among institutions of higher education, government, and employers. Two statutes authorize this program: 15 USC §7442 (cybersecurity) and 42 USC §18993 (AI). CyberAI SFS aligns with the Executive Order 14277 to prioritize AI within scholarship for service programs. CyberAI is managed by NSF’s Directorate for STEM Education in collaboration with the U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

signal.title: 105017 - What works in AI Adoption within DCMS Sectors
signal.description: DCMS are seeking to commission "what works" research into the impact and effectiveness of AI adoption interventions within DCMS sectors. We are interested in two broad sets of questions. The first is analysis of how businesses within DCMS sectors that are in the process of adopting AI achieve this, the challenges they face and the opportunities and benefits realised. We anticipate this will be explored through an ethnographic study that observes how individuals and teams actually use AI tools in their jobs. The second set of questions is what policy interventions work best to support businesses that wish to adopt AI, which we anticipate will be answered by testing hypothetical interventions through randomised control trials (RCTs). Bidders will be able to propose alternative methodologies if they think they suit these questions better; the core need for this project is to produce direct, robust evidence of what works, as opposed to what is self-reported (e.g. through interviews, focus groups, surveys, and similar) to work. This project will be commissioned either through a Competitive Flexible Procedure under the Procurement Act 2023, or through the RM6126 Research and Insights framework. This is part of the DCMS Science and Analysis R&D Programme, which supports R&D capability within the department. This project will run concurrently aside three other large projects across 2027-2030, these include; mapping the specific "user pathways" audiences take to find, consume, and value information; a continuation of previous research to develop data-intensive approaches for capturing engagement at unticketed cultural, heritage, and sporting events/activities/locations, e.g. using mobile app data to model how people participate in our events; and a continuation of previous research to design and improve methods for holistically tracking the long-term impact of major events, tested on a major event. Lot 1: .

signal.title: Open Tender for Douglas Valley Outdoor Recreation and Adventure Tourism Market Research, Branding, Website Development & Wayfinding
signal.description: South Lanarkshire Council seeks a Creative Consultancy to deliver a Market Assessment, Branding Strategy, Website Development, Content Library and Wayfinding Strategy for the Douglas Valley Outdoor Recreation and Adventure Tourism initiative within the Hagshaw Energy Cluster. 1. Market Assessment Review existing project documentation and identify implications for branding, marketing and website development. Analyse visitor data, market trends and audience segmentation, including visitor case studies. Benchmark comparable projects and destinations. Provide recommendations to inform branding, website design, content and future marketing activity. 2. Branding Development Develop and consult on three branding concepts before producing a final identity. Create brand assets including logo, name, tagline, colours, fonts and digital/print applications. Produce brand guidelines covering signage, interpretation, promotional materials and integration with existing site branding. Include recommendations for social media and future marketing activity. 3. Website Design, Build and Launch Create a branded website promoting Douglas Valley as a destination to live, work, visit and enjoy, supporting ambitions to attract up to 100,000 annual visits by 2036. Develop a scalable, content-led website with a planned lifespan of ten years. Include six core pages: Home, About, Explore, See & Stay, News and Contact. The Explore section will feature an interactive map highlighting key recreational and active travel routes, points of interest and route information including distance, elevation, difficulty and duration. Build the site on an accessible CMS suitable for community and council users. Host on a secure UK-based platform with maintenance and support arrangements. Ensure accessibility compliance and provide flexible management of route information and temporary diversions. 4. Photography and Video Library Establish a copyright-cleared library of photography and short-form video content for web, social media and print use. Source content through community engagement, youth-focused workshops and professional photography where required. Content will reflect identified visitor segments and feature strong people-focused imagery. Coverage will include renewable energy, local communities, nature, heritage and identity, local economy and outdoor recreation. Key locations include Coalburn, Douglas, Glenbuck, Glespin, Lesmahagow, Mainshill, Muirkirk, Poneil, Rigside, Douglas Water and Spireslack, alongside significant natural, heritage and recreation assets. 5. Wayfinding Strategy and Design Guidance Develop a first-phase wayfinding strategy focused on Coalburn, Douglas, Glespin, Douglasdale Community Woodland and connecting active travel routes. Establish a hierarchy of signage including gateway signs, orientation panels, interpretation boards, directional signage and waymarkers. Produce a spatial strategy identifying suitable signage locations. Develop design guidance covering dimensions, materials, specification, siting and future rollout. Prepare detailed proposals for priority installations to support future procurement. Work with Community Action Lanarkshire on implementation of information signs, directional signage and waymarkers along the NCN-Coalburn-Douglas route. Ensure all strategy, design and implementation follow inclusive design principles. Lot 1: . signal.title: Model-to-Clinic (M2C) for Precision Medicine with AI: Integrating Imaging with Multimodal Data (PRIMED-AI) (UG3/UH3, Clinical Trial Optional)
signal.description: The overarching goal of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) and its companion opportunities is to establish the Precision Medicine with AI: Integrating Imaging with Multimodal Data (PRIMED-AI) Program to support development of innovative, reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable multimodal AI-based clinical decision support (CDS) tools. PRIMED-AI CDS tools are based on the integration of clinical imaging with other types of multimodal health data to enhance care for patients with a wide range of health conditions. The PRIMED-AI Program seeks to catalyze the adoption of AI-based CDS tools into clinical workflows to enable novel personalized medicine strategies that address significant health challenges.The purpose of this NOFO is to catalyze the translation of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled, image-centered, multimodal CDS tools, developed as Software as a Medical Device, from training and testing of prototypes towards clinical applications that address unmet health challenges in precision medicine. These projects are expected to have high potential for demonstrable, positive impact on patient outcomes and/or healthcare processes.

signal.title: Broad Agency Announcement for Fundamental AI Research
signal.description: The purpose of this combined Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) under Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 35 and Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA) under 2 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) 200.204 (henceforth referred to as “BAA”) is to solicit research proposals for submission to the U.S. Army Artificial Intelligence Integration Center (AI2C) for funding consideration. This Broad Agency Announcement (BAA), for the Army Artificial Intelligence Integration Center (AI2C), is issued under the provisions of paragraph 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), which provides for the acquisition of basic, applied, and advanced research and that part of development not related to the development of a specific system or hardware procurement. This will be done through the competitive selection of proposals, and 10 U.S.C. 4001, 10 U.S.C. 4021, and 10 U.S.C. 4022, which provide the authorities for issuing awards under this announcement for basic, applied, and advanced research. The definitions of basic and applied research may be found at 32 CFR 22.105. Proposals submitted in response to this BAA and selected for award are considered to be the result of full and open competition and in full compliance with the provisions of Public Law 98-369, "The Competition in Contracting Act of 1984" and subsequent amendments. The Army Artificial Intelligence Integration Center (AI2C) is seeking artificial intelligence research and development whitepapers and proposals in support of new technologies and translational research-based approaches that support the identification, alignment, and exploitation of basic, applied, and advanced research. AI2C’s foundational research mission spans basic research (budget activity 6.1) and applied research (budget activity 6.2) as defined by 32 CFR 22.105 but may include advanced technology development (budget activity 6.3) and advanced component development and prototypes (budget activity 6.4) when opportunities arise to directly or indirectly help achieve AI2C’s mission. This publication constitutes a BAA for awards as contemplated in FAR 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 as well as a merit-based, competitive procedure in accordance with the Department of Defense Grant and Agreement Regulations (DoDGARS) at 32 CFR 22.315(a) and the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment Other Transaction Guide version 2.0 dated July 2023.

signal.title: Entwicklung eines Chatbots für das Bergische Servicecenter
signal.description: Die Auftraggeber führen einen wettbewerblichen Dialog zur Entwicklung eines Chatbots für das Bergische Servicecenter sowie für die Verwaltungen der drei Auftraggeber nach den Regelungen der Vergabeverordnung (VgV) durch. Mit der Ausschreibung soll für das Bergische Servicecenter sowie für die drei Auftraggeber ein Chatbot entwickelt werden, mit dem unter anderem sowohl die Angebote des Bergischen ServiceCenters als auch die Angebote der Verwaltungen der Städte Remscheid, Solingen und Wuppertal auf der Ebene der Informationsbereitstellung gegenüber der Bevölkerung und die Interaktion bzgl. der Verwaltungsleistungen der drei Städte ausgeführt bzw. wahrgenommen werden soll. Zukünftig soll der Chatbot entsprechend des aktuellen Stands der Technik weiterentwickelt werden, insbesondere auf der Interaktions- und Transaktionsebene sowie auch zur internen Verwaltungsunterstützung. Die Auftraggeber sollen sowohl gemeinsam für das Bergische Servicecenter als auch jeweils einzeln berechtigt sein, Leistungen vom Auftraggeber hinsichtlich des entwickelten Chatbots abrufen zu können (vgl. Vertragsentwurf, Anlage C zum 2. Verfahrensbrief). Auftragsgegenstand ist die Entwicklung eines Chatbotsystems zur Erfüllung von Serviceauf-gaben bzw. Angeboten des Bergischen Servicecenters auf der Ebene der Informationsbereitstellung gegenüber der Bevölkerung der Städte Remscheid, Solingen und Wuppertal. In den Lösungskonzepten ist bezüglich des Funktionsumfangs des Chatbots die zukünftig wei-tere Entwicklung der Interaktions- und Transaktionsebene sowie die Möglichkeit der internen Verwaltungsunterstützung zu berücksichtigen. Weiterhin ist Gegenstand des Auftrags auch die Pflege, Weiterentwicklung und Anpassung des Chatbotsystems. Das Chatbotsystem soll zum einen im Rahmen der Informationsbereitstellung für Bürger, Unternehmen und andere Informationssuchende insbesondere direkte Auskünfte zu verfüg-baren Dienstleistungen, Weiterleitungen zu entsprechenden Leistungen und Informationen sowie perspektivisch auf Interaktions- und Transaktionsebene unter anderem Beratungen zu Dienstleistungen umsetzen können. Hinsichtlich der internen Verwaltung sollen zum anderen perspektivisch durch das Chatbotsystem unteranderem die Textverwaltung, Rechercheassistenten und ein interner Servicebot unterstützt werden. Der Chatbot soll insbesondere multilingual, als KI-gestütztes Large-Language-Model, mit transparenter, widerspruchsfreier und freundlicher bzw. bürgernaher Sprache, mit stetiger Angabe von Quellen sowie unter Beachtung von datenschutz- und IT-sicherheitsrechtlicher Konformität umgesetzt werden.

translation.description: The contracting authorities are conducting a competitive dialogue for the development of a chatbot for the Bergisches Servicecenter as well as for the administrations of the three contracting authorities in accordance with the provisions of the German Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV). The tender aims to develop a chatbot for the Bergisches Servicecenter and the three contracting authorities, which is to be used to execute or perform, among other things, both the services of the Bergisches ServiceCenter and the services of the administrations of the cities of Remscheid, Solingen and Wuppertal at the level of information provision to the public and interaction regarding the administrative services of the three cities. In the future, the chatbot is to be further developed in line with the current state of the art, particularly at the interaction and transaction level as well as for internal administrative support. The contracting authorities shall be entitled, both jointly for the Bergisches Servicecenter and individually, to call off services from the contractor regarding the developed chatbot (cf. draft contract, Annex C to the 2. Letter of Procedure). The subject of the contract is the development of a chatbot system to fulfil service tasks or services of the Bergisches Servicecenter at the level of information provision to the population of the cities of Remscheid, Solingen and Wuppertal. Regarding the functional scope of the chatbot, the solution concepts must take into account the future further development of the interaction and transaction level as well as the possibility of internal administrative support. Furthermore, the subject of the contract also includes the maintenance, further development and adaptation of the chatbot system. On the one hand, the chatbot system should be able to implement, within the framework of providing information to citizens, companies and other information seekers, in particular direct information on available services, forwarding to corresponding services and information, and prospectively, at the interaction and transaction level, among other things, advice on services. On the other hand, with regard to internal administration, the chatbot system is prospectively intended to support, among other things, text management, research assistants and an internal service bot. The chatbot is to be implemented in particular as a multilingual, AI-supported large language model, with transparent, consistent and friendly or citizen-oriented language, with constant citation of sources, and in compliance with data protection and IT security law.
translation.title: Development of a chatbot for the Bergisches Servicecenter

signal.title: Poverty Dashboard for Dumfries and Galloway
signal.description: Dumfries and Galloway Council intend to commission an organisation to develop and implement the creation of a local Poverty dashboard, designed to provide a clear, accessible view of child poverty across Dumfries and Galloway. The dashboard should be accessible to partner organisations and any other interested party. Dumfries and Galloway Council serve a region of around 148,000 people across the South West of Scotland, stretching from Stranraer in the West, to Moffat and Annan in the East. We are the 3rd largest local authority by area in Scotland. The latest published statistics show that the rate of child poverty in Dumfries and Galloway is 22.7%. This equates to 5,672 children and young people living in poverty in the region. For example, there are some real challenges around improving health outcomes for those experiencing poverty in the early years and to ensure that all families eligible for free school meals are reached. Lot 1: . Dumfries and Galloway have received funding through the Scottish Governments Fairer Futures initiative. The project is early in its inception but has the long-term goal to deliver systematic change in the way public services support parents and families out of poverty. Our approach is to use existing principles and approaches to put families first, focusing on prevention rather than cure. To help achieve this, accurately measuring poverty and low income is crucial, and the availability of real-time data is vital for effective policy-making. The dashboard would have geographic layers, allowing users to explore poverty data at varying levels of granularity, offering insights into where support is most needed, with a particular focus on priority groups identified by the Scottish Government. These include lone-parent households, families with a disabled member, large families, and households with a mother under the age of 25. It is hoped that data can be gathered that will make meaningful impact to household income, targeting those who are not currently accessing all the additional help and support they can. In addition it’s important that we understand the landscape of our household in poverty, not in our dense areas of deprivation. It would be sage if this could also include pertinent health related data around missed appointments, or additional useful information which might allow for a targeted approach to reduce health inequality. The dashboard should; -Filter data by employment status, housing tenure, and age group, enabling a nuanced understanding of the different dimensions of poverty. -Be a dynamic platform with regularly updated data, that can be continually used to inform decision making. -Be publicly accessible, this openness is essential for building trust and ensuring that anti-poverty efforts are responsive to the lived experiences of families across the region. The purpose of the Poverty Dashboard is to make it easier for the Council and its partners, working with our families in poverty, to easily identify the areas of greatest need to support an evidence based and targeted approach when tackling poverty and inequality in the region.. It is anticipated that this procurement requirement will be conducted through Quick Quote portal as a non-regulated procedure, interested organisations are encouraged to express an interest to be added to the quick quote where this goes as planned.

signal.title: KI-basierte Detektion von Totästen
signal.description: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung und prototypische Umsetzung eines Systems zur automatisierten Detektion von Totästen innerhalb der Infrastruktur der Autobahn GmbH des Bundes Funktionale Leistungsbeschreibung: KI-basierte Detektion von Totästen 1. Einführung und Zielstellung Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung und prototypische Umsetzung eines Systems zur automatisierten Detektion von Totästen innerhalb der Infrastruktur der Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. Ziel ist, ein digitales Werkzeug bereitzustellen, das die visuelle Inspektion durch eine KI-basierte Bildanalyse unterstützt und somit die Effizienz und Sicherheit der Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen signifikant erhöht. Die konkrete technische Umsetzung liegt im Ermessen der Bieter. Bei der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Umsetzung des KI-Systems sind alle einschlägigen gesetzlichen und regulatorischen Vorgaben einzuhalten. Der Auftragnehmer hat insbesondere sicherzustellen, dass das zu entwickelnde KI-System im Einklang mit den Anforderungen der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 über Künstliche Intelligenz (KI-Verordnung - KI-VO) steht, soweit diese anwendbar ist.2. Funktionale Anforderungen an das System (Leistungsprogramm) Die zu erbringende Leistung muss folgende Kernfunktionen erfüllen, die in einem Proof-of-Concept /Machbarkeitsnachweis (PoC) und in einer darauf aufbauenden prototypischen Anwendung nachzuweisen sind. 2.1. Datenerfassung Das System muss in der Lage sein, visuelle Daten (Bilder oder Videosequenzen) aus einer mobilen Einheit (z. B. einem Fahrzeug) in einer für die KI-Analyse geeigneten Qualität zu erfassen. Funktion: Automatisierte und kontinuierliche Erfassung von Bildmaterial der umgebenden Baumlandschaft. 2.2. KI-Algorithmus zur Bildauswertung Das Herzstück der Anwendung ist ein KI-Algorithmus, der eine automatisierte Analyse der erfassten Bilddaten vornimmt. Funktion: Automatische Erkennung, Klassifizierung und räumliche Lokalisierung (Positionierung) von Totästen. Anforderung: Der Algorithmus muss eine definierte Mindesttrefferquote und Zuverlässigkeit in verschiedenen Umgebungsbedingungen (Tageslicht, Schattenwurf, Witterung) erreichen. Die Ergebnisse müssen eindeutig zuzuordnen und nachvollziehbar sein. 2.3. Frontend-Anwendung (Benutzeroberfläche) Das System muss eine benutzerfreundliche Schnittstelle zur Darstellung und Verwaltung der Analyseergebnisse bereitstellen. Funktion: Grafische Aufbereitung der KI-Ergebnisse für den Praxiseinsatz Anforderung: Das Frontend muss eine übersichtliche Darstellung der detektierten Totäste auf einer Karte ermöglichen. Zudem müssen im Frontend Funktionen zur Validierung, Kommentierung und Freigabe der Ergebnisse durch den Nutzer enthalten sein. 2.4. Datenmanagement und Schnittstellen Anforderung: Ein autarkes System muss angeboten werden, welches die Möglichkeit zur Datenbefüllung- und Datenintegration ermöglicht und dessen Ergebnisse einsehbar sind. Eine Integration in bestehende IT-Systeme der Autobahn GmbH ist nicht vorgesehen und nicht erforderlich. Das KI-System wird vollständig durch den Auftragnehmer betrieben. Der Auftragnehmer hat die im Rahmen der Leistungserbringung generierten Daten und Analyseergebnisse in elektronischer Form bereitzustellen. Dabei sind Formate zu verwenden, die sowohl für die Auftraggeberin lesbar als auch maschinell weiterverarbeitbar sind. Weitere technische Schnittstellen oder Systemanbindungen sind nicht Bestandteil der zu erbringenden Leistung. 3. Nicht-funktionale Anforderungen Über die genannten Funktionen hinaus, sind folgenden Qualitäten des Systems von Bedeutung: Skalierbarkeit: Das System muss so konzipiert sein, dass es bei Bedarf auf größere Datenmengen und weitere Einsatzgebiete ausgeweitet werden kann. IT-Sicherheit: Die gesamte Architektur und die Datenverarbeitung müssen den aktuellen IT-Sicherheitsstandards entsprechen, insbesondere in Bezug auf den Schutz von Daten und Systemen in kritischen Infrastrukturen. Wartbarkeit: Das System soll so konzipiert sein, dass es einfach gewartet und weiterentwickelt werden kann. Die Nutzungsrechte der entwickelten Software (KI) verbleiben ausschließlich bei der Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. 4. Projektergebnis Nachweis der Funktionsfähigkeit (PoC): Nach der ersten Phase ist ein funktionsfähiger Nachweis (PoC) zu erbringen, der die Machbarkeit der KI-basierten Detektion demonstriert. Prototypische Anwendung: Das finale Ergebnis ist eine voll funktionsfähige, prototypische Anwendung, die alle oben genannten funktionalen und nicht-funktionalen Anforderungen erfüllt und in der Praxis getestet werden kann. Hinweis: Die Entscheidung über die konkrete technische Umsetzung (z. B. verwendete Programmiersprachen, spezifische KI-Frameworks etc.) bleibt den Bietern überlassen. Entscheidend ist die Erfüllung der beschriebenen Funktionen und Ziele. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt 24 Monate ab Vertragsbeginn. Innerhalb dieses Zeitraums ist das KI-System vollständig zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen. Die Datenlieferungen gemäß Abschnitt 2.4 sind ebenfalls innerhalb dieses Zeitraums regelmäßig zu erbringen.

translation.description: The subject of this tender is the design, development and prototypical implementation of a system for the automated detection of dead branches within the infrastructure of Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. Functional specification: AI-based detection of dead branches 1. Introduction and objectives The subject of this tender is the design, development and prototypical implementation of a system for the automated detection of dead branches within the infrastructure of Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. The objective is to provide a digital tool that supports visual inspection through AI-based image analysis, thereby significantly increasing the efficiency and safety of maintenance measures. The specific technical implementation is at the discretion of the bidders. All relevant legal and regulatory requirements must be complied with during the design, development and implementation of the AI system. In particular, the contractor must ensure that the AI system to be developed is in accordance with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 on Artificial Intelligence (AI Act), insofar as it is applicable.2. Functional requirements for the system (service programme) The service to be provided must fulfil the following core functions, which must be demonstrated in a proof-of-concept (PoC) and in a subsequent prototypical application. 2.1. Data acquisition The system must be capable of capturing visual data (images or video sequences) from a mobile unit (e.g. a vehicle) in a quality suitable for AI analysis. Function: Automated and continuous capture of image material of the surrounding tree landscape. 2.2. AI algorithm for image evaluation The core of the application is an AI algorithm that performs an automated analysis of the captured image data. Function: Automatic detection, classification and spatial localisation (positioning) of dead branches. Requirement: The algorithm must achieve a defined minimum hit rate and reliability under various environmental conditions (daylight, shadows, weather). The results must be clearly assignable and traceable. 2.3. Frontend application (user interface) The system must provide a user-friendly interface for displaying and managing the analysis results. Function: Graphical processing of the AI results for practical use. Requirement: The frontend must enable a clear display of the detected dead branches on a map. In addition, the frontend must contain functions for validation, commenting and approval of the results by the user. 2.4. Data management and interfaces Requirement: A self-sufficient system must be offered which enables data entry and data integration and whose results can be viewed. Integration into existing IT systems of Autobahn GmbH is not intended and is not required. The AI system will be operated entirely by the contractor. The contractor must provide the data and analysis results generated during the provision of the service in electronic form. Formats must be used that are both readable by the contracting authority and machine-processable. Further technical interfaces or system connections are not part of the service to be provided. 3. Non-functional requirements Beyond the functions mentioned, the following qualities of the system are important: Scalability: The system must be designed in such a way that it can be expanded to larger data volumes and further areas of application if required. IT security: The entire architecture and data processing must comply with current IT security standards, particularly with regard to the protection of data and systems in critical infrastructure. Maintainability: The system should be designed so that it can be easily maintained and further developed. The usage rights for the developed software (AI) remain exclusively with Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. 4. Project result Proof of functionality (PoC): After the first phase, a functional proof (PoC) must be provided that demonstrates the feasibility of the AI-based detection. Prototypical application: The final result is a fully functional, prototypical application that meets all the functional and non-functional requirements mentioned above and can be tested in practice. Note: The decision regarding the specific technical implementation (e.g. programming languages used, specific AI frameworks, etc.) is left to the bidders. The decisive factor is the fulfilment of the described functions and objectives. The contract duration is 24 months from the start of the contract. Within this period, the AI system must be fully developed and provided. The data deliveries in accordance with section 2.4 must also be provided regularly within this period.
translation.title: AI-based detection of dead branches

translation.description: The subject of the intended procurement is the awarding of an integrated overall service for the SAP technology stack of BARMER and HEK. The service to be procured comprises taking over application responsibility, platform operation and infrastructure operation for the operation of the statutory health insurance (GKV) core system oscare® in an SAP S/4HANA environment. Lot PAR-0000: SAP Operation and AI Integration. BARMER and HEK are jointly conducting an EU-wide market consultation in accordance with Section 28 of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV). The aim is to determine which providers on the European market are in a position to provide the SAP technology stack of BARMER and HEK - consisting of application responsibility, platform operation and infrastructure operation - for the operation of the GKV core system oscare® in an SAP S/4HANA environment. Ensuring the SAP software licence required for operation is an integral part of the overall service.

signal.title: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION: AI & Data Factory - Expert Services for AI and Data Development, Governance and Continuous Operations
signal.description: DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT AND MARKET DIALOGUE The subject of the planned procurement is the acquisition of expert services for the establishment, development and operation of a centralized AI and Data Factory service (hereinafter the “AI & Data Factory”). The AI and Data Factory will support the Contracting Entity in developing, deploying, maintaining and continuously improving data, artificial intelligence, machine learning and analytics solutions and capabilities throughout their lifecycle. The AI and Data Factory service may include, but is not limited to, the following services: Decision Intelligence and Data Platform services Design, development, testing, deployment and continuous lifecycle management of Decision Intelligence solutions, including business intelligence, data science, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI and agentic AI, as well as related data platform capabilities. The services may include, for example: - design and implementation of data, business intelligence, advanced analytics, machine-learning and AI solutions; - continuous development, maintenance, monitoring and lifecycle management of Decision Intelligence solutions; - continuous validation and quality assurance, including model behaviour, outputs, end-result quality, data quality and data usage; - development, deployment and operation of AI and AI agent governance practices; - development, operation and continuous improvement of data platforms; and - other AI-, data-, analytics- and technology-related expert and consulting services supporting the objectives of the procurement. Data Governance and Management services Data governance and data management services may be provided as part of projects, continuous development activities and ongoing data management operations. The services may include, for example: - external data sourcing, data content development, data validation and data migration; - continuous data quality monitoring and improvement; and - development, implementation and follow-up of master data management processes for agreed data domains. The services are expected to be delivered in close collaboration with the Contracting Entity’s internal experts and other suppliers. The preliminary allocation of responsibilities between the Contracting Entity and the Supplier or Suppliers will be further specified based on the procurement preparation and market dialogue. The Contracting Entity intends to select 3 - 5 or more Suppliers. The final procurement and service delivery model, including the number of Suppliers and the allocation of responsibilities, will be determined during the preparation of the procurement. OBJECTIVES OF THE MARKET DIALOGUE The Contracting Authority seeks market input on the planned scope of the procurement, service model, preliminary service descriptions, procurement structure, competence requirements, commercial models and other elements relevant to the successful establishment and operation of the AI Factory. Suppliers are encouraged not only to comment on the Contracting Authority's preliminary proposals, but also to challenge the proposed approaches and suggest alternative, innovative or more effective solutions and operating models based on their experience, market practices and emerging AI capabilities. The Contracting Authority particularly welcomes ideas that may improve the scope, structure, flexibility, scalability, commercial model or long-term effectiveness of the procurement. The purpose of the market dialogue is to utilize market expertise in developing the procurement and to ensure that the final approach is feasible, proportionate, future-proof and aligned with market capabilities, while enabling innovation and the effective adoption of evolving AI technologies, services and operating models. PRELIMINARY TIMETABLE - Market dialogue: H2/2026 - Publication of the Invitation to Tender: Q1/2026 - Evaluation of tenders: H1/2027 - Procurement decision: H1/2027 - Contract commencement: H1/2027 ADDITIONAL INFORMATION This notice is a Prior Information Notice. It is not a contract notice or a call for tenders. The Prior Information Notice includes an invitation to participate in a market dialogue. All interested suppliers are invited to participate in technical discussions with the Contracting Entity concerning the planned procurement. The purpose of the dialogue is to discuss the procurement at a general level and to obtain market feedback on the proposed scope and definition of the procurement. Suppliers interested in participating in the market dialogue are requested to submit their expression of interest by email to tommi.aarnio@vr.fi no later than 28 September 2026 at 12:00 noon (Finnish time). Participation in the market dialogue does not oblige the Contracting Entity to proceed with the procurement, nor does it oblige suppliers to participate in any subsequent tendering procedure. Interested suppliers will be provided with preliminary procurement materials and/or questions for review and comments. The Contracting Entity may organize written consultation rounds, joint market dialogue sessions and, where considered appropriate, bilateral meetings with selected suppliers. The Contracting Entity reserves the right to amend the scope, content, procurement model, timetable and market dialogue process during the preparation of the procurement. No compensation will be paid to suppliers for participating in the market dialogue or for providing comments.

signal.title: Projekt 1000 - "Agentic AI: Prüfanforderungen für LLM-basierte agentische künstliche Intelligenz (PRAKI)"
signal.description: Der Einsatz von (teil-) autonomen KI-Agenten (Agentic AI) wird in naher Zukunft zu einer zunehmenden Automatisierung einer breiten Palette an Aufgaben führen. Bisherige Prüfkataloge und Standards des BSI berücksichtigen diese neuartigen Einsatzmöglichkeiten von KI noch nicht; Ziel des Projekts ist es daher, die wichtigsten Use-Cases im Bereich der agentischen KI zu identifizieren, für diese Prüfanforderungen zu entwickeln und auf Basis derer eine Generalisierung für andere Use-Cases zu erarbeiten. Die Ergebnisse des Projekts fließen direkt in die „Stand der Technik“-Bibliothek ein, aus der sich der neue Grundschutz++ speist/generiert.
signal.buyer_name: Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik

translation.buyer_original: Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik
translation.description: The use of (semi-)autonomous AI agents (Agentic AI) will lead to increasing automation of a wide range of tasks in the near future. Previous BSI test catalogues and standards do not yet take these novel applications of AI into account; the aim of the project is therefore to identify the most important use cases in the field of agentic AI, to develop testing requirements for them, and to work out a generalisation for other use cases based on these. The results of the project will flow directly into the "state-of-the-art" library, from which the new Grundschutz++ is fed/generated.

signal.description: Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia tiedolla johtamisen asiantuntijapalveluja, AI-avusteiset asiantuntijapalveluja sekä AI-agenttikirjastoja tuottavia toimijoita sekä vaihtoehtoja. Tietopyynnön tavoitteena on varmistaa Keusoten käyttöön riittävät ja osaavat tiedolla johtamisen asiantuntijapalvelut, AI-avusteiset asiantuntijapalvelut sekä Keusoten asiantuntijaresursseille tarjottava AI-agenttikirjasto vuosille 2026–2029. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialuetta toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä tai sen liitteissä kuvatulla tavalla ja tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää toteuttamatta. Tässä ilmoituksessa esitetyt tiedot ja kuvaukset ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia ennakkotietoja, jotka eivät sido Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialuetta. Kyseessä on vain tietopyyntö eikä se johda selvityksessä olevan ratkaisun kilpailutukseen vaan hankintaprosessi käynnistetään erillisellä päätöksellä. Tietopyynnön vastaukset tulee toimittaa suomen kielellä. Tulevan kilpailutuksen onnistumisen varmistamiseksi on tärkeää, että tarjoajat antavat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Kaikki tietopyynnössä saadut tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisesti. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. signal.title: Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) Framework
signal.description: Scottish Enterprise are putting place a framework for the provision of a customer engagement platform and associated implementation and professional services. The framework is being established to allow for named partner bodies to access the framework through their own call off. The framework will be awarded for the full scope outlined in the Invitation to Tender (ITT). The framework will be in place for 4 years and call-offs will not exceed 10 years in duration. At the same time Scottish Enterprise will award a call-off for their own specific requirements as outlined. Lot 1: . Scottish Enterprise are establishing a Customer Engagement Platform Framework on behalf of: Business Gateway (“BG”) Creative Scotland (“CS”) Highlands and Islands Enterprise (“HIE”) Scottish Enterprise (“SE”) Scottish Funding Council (“SFC”) Skills Development Scotland (“SDS”) South of Scotland Enterprise (“SoSE”). VisitScotland (“VS”) The scope of this procurement is to appoint a single-supplier framework for a modern Customer Engagement Platform for the organisations outlined in above to access. The framework will provide participating organisations with access to Customer Engagement Platform software licences and subscriptions, integration, implementation, data migration, platform capability services, professional services and support and managed services throughout the life of the framework. The platform will deliver consistent, high-quality services at scale, while improving both customer and colleague experience. The framework will be in place for 4 years and call-offs will not exceed 10 years in duration. At the same time Scottish Enterprise will award a call-off for their own specific requirements as outlined in the tender documentation.. Economic operators may be excluded from this competition if they are in any of the situations referred to in Regulation 58 of the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015.

signal.title: Αναβάθμιση και επέκταση πολυκαναλικού συστήματος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555
signal.description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η αναβάθμιση και επέκταση του Πολυκαναλικού συστήματος ενημέρωσης και εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555, το οποίο λειτουργεί από τη 1/10/2022, ως ενιαίος κόμβος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών και επιχειρήσεων για θέματα αρμοδιότητας του Υπουργείου Εργασίας και Κοινωνικής Ασφάλισης και των εποπτευομένων φορέων του. Στο πλαίσιο της αναβάθμισης, ενισχύεται η ψηφιακή αρχιτεκτονική και τα λογισμικά υποσυστήματα, όπως η διαδικτυακή πύλη, η γνωσιακή βάση, λύσεις τεχνητής νοημοσύνης και το ticketing, ώστε το 1555 να μεταβεί σταδιακά από ένα κυρίως φωνοκεντρικό μοντέλο σε ένα ισορροπημένο μοντέλο εξυπηρέτησης, όπου οι πιο σύνθετες και ευαίσθητες υποθέσεις παραμένουν σε ανθρώπινη εξυπηρέτηση, με ενίσχυση εξειδικευμένων εκπροσώπων, ενώ, οι απλούστερες υποθέσεις κλείνουν μέσω self service υπηρεσιών και αυτοματισμών. Ειδικότερα, προβλέπεται αξιοποίηση λύσεων ΑΙ τόσο προς τον πολίτη, όσο και προς τον εκπρόσωπο, όπως IVR και ΑΙ agent για αναγνώριση προθέσεων και δρομολόγηση σε ψηφιακές λύσεις ή στους κατάλληλους εξειδικευμένους εκπροσώπους, εργαλεία agent assist που αντλούν περιεχόμενο από τη γνωσιακή βάση για μείωση λαθών και χρόνου χειρισμού, καθώς και analytics για κατανόηση αιτημάτων και καλύτερο σχεδιασμό στελέχωσης. Παράλληλα, ενισχύεται η διαλειτουργικότητα σε επίπεδο υποδομών ή και services με το Σύστημα Διαχείρισης Αιτημάτων Πολιτών (CC ticketing) και η αξιοποίηση δεδομένων από το ticketing και τη γνωσιακή βάση, με πρόβλεψη συνεχούς βελτίωσης μέσω ανατροφοδότησης και ανάλυσης συνομιλιών. Η λειτουργία των εξειδικευμένων συμβούλων θα επεκταθεί και θα ενισχυθεί, ώστε οι πολίτες να έχουν ακόμα μεγαλύτερη πρόσβαση σε προσωποποιημένη πληροφόρηση. Τα ψηφιακά συστήματα θα αναβαθμιστούν περαιτέρω και θα εισαχθούν και νέα, με στόχο την ενίσχυση της εξυπηρέτησης. Ομάδα εμπειρογνωμόνων θα μπορεί να πραγματοποιεί στοχευμένες μελέτες σε ειδική θεματολογία των εξυπηρετούμενων Φορέων, καθώς και θα μπορούν να πραγματοποιούνται έρευνες, ώστε να ενισχύονται περαιτέρω και οι Φορείς μέσα από το έργο. Η ανάπτυξη και η διαχείριση του έργου γίνεται σε πακέτα εργασίας ως ακολούθως : I. I. Δομή επικοινωνίας και εξυπηρέτησης κοινού II. Τεχνικές Υποδομές III. Έρευνες ικανοποίησης και Διασφάλιση ποιότητας IV. Ενίσχυση φορέων σε θεματολογία – ειδικές έρευνες V. Διαχείριση έργου VI. Εκπαίδευση στην εξυπηρέτηση Αναβάθμιση και επέκταση πολυκαναλικού συστήματος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555

translation.buyer_name: SPECIAL SERVICE EXECUTIVE STRUCTURE NSRF OF THE MINISTRY OF LABOUR AND SOCIAL SECURITY
translation.buyer_original: ΕΙΔΙΚΗ ΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΕΠΙΤΕΛΙΚΗ ΔΟΜΗ ΕΣΠΑ ΥΠΟΥΡΓΕΙΟΥ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΗΣ ΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗΣ
translation.description: The subject of the contract is the upgrade and expansion of the multi-channel citizen information and service system 1555, which has been operated by 1/10/2022 as a single service hub for citizens and businesses regarding matters falling within the remit of the Ministry of Labour and Social Security and its supervised bodies. As part of the upgrade, the digital architecture and software subsystems, such as the web portal, knowledge base, artificial intelligence solutions and ticketing, are being enhanced so that 1555 can gradually transition from a predominantly voice-centric model to a balanced service model, where more complex and sensitive cases remain with human service through the reinforcement of specialised representatives, while simpler cases are closed via self-service services and automation. Specifically, the use of AI solutions is provided for both citizens and representatives, such as IVRs and AI agents for intent recognition and routing to digital solutions or appropriate specialised representatives, agent assist tools that retrieve content from the knowledge base to reduce errors and handling time, as well as analytics to understand requests and better plan staffing. At the same time, interoperability at the infrastructure or service level with the Citizen Request Management System (CC ticketing) and the utilisation of data from ticketing and the knowledge base are being enhanced, with provision for continuous improvement through feedback and conversation analysis. The operation of specialised consultants will be expanded and enhanced so that citizens have even greater access to personalised information. Digital systems will be further upgraded and new ones introduced with the aim of enhancing service delivery. A team of experts will be able to carry out targeted studies on specific subject matters of the serviced bodies, and surveys may also be conducted to further strengthen the bodies through the project. The development and management of the project are organised into work packages as follows: I. Public communication and service structure II. Technical Infrastructures III. Satisfaction surveys and Quality Assurance IV. Strengthening of bodies on specific subject matters – special surveys V. Project management VI. Service training Upgrade and expansion of a multi-channel citizen service system 1555
translation.title: Upgrade and expansion of a multi-channel citizen service system 1555

signal.title: Udbud med forhandling om udvikling af AI-baseret simulationsredskab til træning af børnesamtaler
signal.description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter indgåelse af én (1) kontrakt vedrørende Ordregivers anskaffelse af udvikling af et AI-baseret simulationsredskab til træning af børnesamtaler. På baggrund af nærværende udbud vil der blive indgået én (1) fælles kontrakt mellem leverandøren og den Ansvarlige Ordregiver, jf. udbudsbetingelsernes punkt 1.2, som handler på vegne af samtlige deltagende ordregivere. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver er Professionshøjskolen Absalon, som er bemyndiget til at varetage samtlige rettigheder og forpligtelserne i henhold til kontrakten og optræder som kontraktpart over for leverandøren. Leverandøren kan således alene rette krav mod den Ansvarlige Ordregiver. Øvrige deltagende ordregivere er ikke direkte kontraktparter og hæfter hverken individuelt eller solidarisk for opfyldelsen af kontrakten. Professionshøjskolen Absalon udbyder i samarbejde med de øvrige professionshøjskoler, Red Barnet, Barndom Uden Vold og Ole Kirk’s Fond en opgave om udvikling af et AI-baseret simulationsredskab, som i udbudsmaterialet betegnes Løsningen. Formålet er at styrke socialrådgiveres og socialrådgiverstuderendes kompetencer til at gennemføre samtaler med børn i sårbare situationer, herunder børn der kan have været udsat for vold eller overgreb. Løsningen skal skabe et realistisk, trygt og læringsorienteret træningsmiljø, hvor brugerne kan forberede sig på børnesamtaler, gennemføre samtaler med digitale avatarer, få vejledning og feedback fra en Tutor og efterfølgende analysere deres samtaler med henblik på læring og refleksion. Den skal både kunne anvendes i socialrådgiveruddannelsen, i efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb og i den kommunale praksis. Den første version, som dette udbud omfatter, skal give mulighed for tale- og tekstbaseret interaktion med fire avatarer i alderen 9–11 år, som repræsenterer forskellige baggrunde og sagstyper. Hertil kommer en Tutor, der understøtter brugeren før, under og efter samtalen gennem forberedende information, løbende faglige hints og efterfølgende debriefing. Løsningen skal rumme både fulde samtaleforløb og kortere moduler, hvor enkelte samtaleteknikker kan trænes isoleret. På længere sigt er ambitionen at udvide løsningen med mere avancerede modaliteter såsom mimik og kropssprog samt realtidsanalyse af nonverbal kommunikation. Ordregiver ønsker derfor at tiltrække leverandører, som ikke alene kan levere den udbudte løsning, men også kan tænke visionært i forhold til at skabe en fremtidssikret og innovativ platform. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver stiller et omfattende vidensgrundlag til rådighed i form af praksisnære cases, anonymiserede børnesamtaler og fagpersoners ekspertise, og vil desuden bidrage aktivt med faglig sparring under udviklingen. Tilbuddene vil blive vurderet på realiserbarhed og risikovurdering, funktionalitet og sikkerhed, realismen i avatarerne, tutorens faglige kvalitet samt den samlede brugeroplevelse og tekniske robusthed. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver er berettiget til at opsige kontrakten ved Delleverancedag 1 (POC), udelukkende med henblik på at kunne bringe projektet til ophør, såfremt det under Delleverance 1 - POC viser sig, at der foreligger tekniske udfordringer, som gør det umuligt at udvikle en egnet og anvendelig Løsning til det formål, som kontrakten understøtter, jf. Kontraktens punkt 31.2.1. Det er dog den Ansvarlige Ordregivers klare hensigt at gennemføre udviklingen af en fuldstændig Løsning, der fungerer efter sit formål. Af hensyn til fastlagt budget har Ordregiver fastlagt et prisloft for Leverancevederlaget. Leverancevederlaget, herunder prisen for Afklaringsfasen og Leverancen, jf. Kontraktbilag 01 – Tidsplan, må således maksimalt være fem (5) mio. DKK ekskl. moms. Inden for det fastlagte prisloft på fem (5) mio. DKK ekskl. moms ønsker Ordregiver at fremme løsninger, der kombinerer høj teknisk kvalitet og innovationshøjde. Med dette udbud tilstræber Ordregiver at understøtte en konkurrence, der ikke alene baseres på pris, men også på Tilbudsgivernes evne til at tænke langsigtet og visionært. Ordregiver redegør derfor for de strategiske og teknologiske ambitioner for Løsningen med henblik på at opfordre tilbudsgivere til at præsentere forslag, der afspejler en fremtidssikret og teknologisk avanceret tilgang. Samtidig er det vigtigt for Ordregiver, at Løsningen kan driftes bæredygtigt inden for de økonomiske rammer, der gælder for professionshøjskolernes fælles drift. Ordregiver ønsker derfor at indgå kontrakt med en Leverandør, der kan sikre iderigdom og teknisk snilde i forhold til at udvikle en Løsning, der opfylder de ønskede behov, men som samtidig kan driftes af professionshøjskolerne i fællesskab - hvor samtaleflow vægtes højere end visualisering af barnets nonverbale sprog.
